Overview

Sukhothai is a city in Sukhothai with a population of 35,000. Thailand’s first capital and a UNESCO World Heritage site, home to the magnificent Sukhothai Historical Park with its ancient temples and Buddha statues. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. The city enjoys abundant sunshine, with about 260 sunny days a year.
